indication_area: Hepatology (pruritus in progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis; Alagille syndrome)
geography: Worldwide (U.S. plus international markets; Albireo prints one product revenue line)

launch_evidence.quote: We commenced our commercial launch of Bylvay for the treatment of pruritus in patients with PFIC ages 3 months or older in the United States in July 2021 after we received FDA approval of Bylvay on July 20, 2021.

series_end_reason: Albireo was acquired by Ipsen (not an SEC filer). Its last periodic report is the 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2022; it filed no fourth-quarter 2022 release or 2022 Form 10-K. The 8-K filed 2023-03-02 (accession 0001104659-23-027946, item 2.01) reports that Merger Sub 'merged with and into the Company ... with the Company continuing as the surviving corporation ... as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent' (Ipsen Biopharmaceuticals, Inc.), and Albireo filed a Form 15-12G on 2023-03-14.
search_log: Listed every filing of Albireo Pharma (CIK 1322505, formerly Biodel) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks carrying item 2.02 (2021-08 to 2023-06) and every 10-Q/10-K; parsed every table row. All forms filed 2022-11-09 to 2023-03-31 were listed: 8-Ks (items 5.02/7.01; 1.01/7.01; 8.01; 2.01 etc.), SC TO/14D9 tender documents, S-8 POS, 15-12G - none carries a 2022Q4 figure.
Rows: 'Product revenue, net' of each quarterly earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1). Bylvay was Albireo's only product; royalty and license revenue are separate lines and are excluded.
Checks: the 2021Q4 release prints full-year 2021 product revenue 6,993 = 1,060 + 5,933; each release's three-month figure equals the 10-Q statement of operations.
